# ZenCloudMedia

> Independent short-form news reel studio publishing AI-assisted video explainers on oil markets, geopolitics, science, space, AI, and world events.

## What ZenCloudMedia Publishes

ZenCloudMedia produces short-form video reels (60–90 seconds) distributed on YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Facebook Reels. Each reel covers a single fast-moving story with sourced research, motion graphics, word-level captions, and narration.

Topics covered: oil and energy markets, geopolitics and global conflict, artificial intelligence, science discoveries, space news, and world events.

Production uses AI-assisted tooling (research, script drafting, image generation, text-to-speech, automated captions) with human editorial review for topic selection, framing, and publication decisions.

## Content Series

- Oil Price Pulse — regular briefings on WTI crude, Brent crude, and U.S. gas prices with market context
- World News — curated international top stories
- AI News — artificial intelligence developments and industry shifts
- Science News — research discoveries and science developments
- Space News — astronomy, space exploration, and satellite events
- Gaming News — gaming industry news
- Special Reels — longer documentary-style explainers on specific topics

## Editorial Standards

ZenCloudMedia selects stories where a short explainer adds practical context rather than outrage. Scripts are built from public reporting, official releases, and primary data sources. AI tools assist research and production; final editorial decisions are human-led. See https://www.zencloudweb.com/editorial-policy for the full policy.
